scene.background: cracked, arid desert floor with dry, cracked earth stretching to a distant horizon where a faint outline of a white vehicle is visible
scene.lighting: warm and diffused, likely from late afternoon sun, casting long, soft shadows and creating a gentle glow on the women’s faces and garments
scene.camera_angle: low and slightly wide, capturing the full length of the procession and emphasizing the scale of the desert and the unity of the group
scene.style: documentary, photo-realistic quality, with fine detail in fabric textures, the roughness of the burlap sacks, and the subtle grain of the dry soil
scene.mood: quiet dignity, hardship, and collective purpose
scene.color_palette: rich yet earthy, with saturated hues against the muted desert tones

clothing.attire: flowing, richly embroidered robes and headscarves
clothing.colors: deep purples, reds, emerald greens, and blacks

attributes.accessory: large, rough-hewn burlap sack balanced on her head
